$comment: Songs allowed into the SHIPPED starter catalogue. A song is included only when it is listed here WITH "attested": true — an explicit claim by the packager that they hold the rights to redistribute it. Everything else is excluded, including every corpus in scripts/output (Beatles / McGill / Rock Corpus / Lalo Chezia are all restricted; see scripts/catalog/sources.ts). Add entries as {"songId": "local-my-tune", "attested": true, "note": "written by me, 2026"}.
